primary_meaning: the Church (or people of God) as a lesser light reflecting the light of Christ/the Sun

alternatives.meaning: mutability, changeableness, or the changeable world/order (due to waxing and waning)
basis: phases of the moon as observed natural phenomenon
Revelation 12:1 (moon under feet as dominion over changeable things)

alternatives.meaning: cosmic portents of judgment or the end of an age (darkened or turned to blood)
a maternal/familial figure or secondary authority in visionary/dream contexts

notes: Meanings are highly context-dependent across creation, prophetic, apocalyptic, and allegorical readings; the Church-as-reflector motif is frequent in patristic/medieval allegory but not a universal or exclusive consensus across all Christian traditions and genres.
